title: Contested case on 53-lot subdivision permit
summary: The commission has set a contested case hearing, a formal, trial-like proceeding, for February 11 on a permit request for up to 53 single-family lots. The request covers about 28 acres. The commission took up the request at its October 22, 2024 meeting.
